row:
Welcome to my YouTube channel, a treasure trove of snippets of knowledge and handy hints in the field of veterinary neurology. 

Who am I? 
I bring expertise from specialist referral practice and academia to offer valuable insights and guidance. The aim is to breakdown down complex veterinary neurology concepts into digestible and practical tips.

What do I do? 
My research is dedicated to understanding cerebrospinal fluid disorders, particularly focusing on Canine Chiari malformation and syringomyelia. I am particularly passionate about raising awareness of diseases caused by selective breeding for poor head and body shape. I promote responsible breeding practices to minimize the suffering of animals affected by hereditary conditions.

Who is this channel for?
My content is accessible to both professionals and lay audiences. Join the community as you delve into the world of veterinary neurology. 

The views expressed are my own
